:::{#sol-flat-point-compare}

The prediction $3.98$ (@sol-flat-point-predict)
and the exact [value](functions.qmd#def-value) $3.9801$ (@sol-flat-point-exact)
differ by $0.0001$,
which is $\smallconst^2$.
The [linear approximation](calculus.qmd#def-linear-approximation) drops everything of that order and smaller,
so halving the step quarters the error.
That trade is the whole bargain of [gradient descent](optimization.qmd#def-gradient-descent),
the step-by-step method of fitting models
that the optimization page defines.
We take a step in the direction the derivative recommends,
and the recommendation is trustworthy
only as far as the step is small.

:::
